comparisons.name: N=256/q32 three-generator comparison
comparisons.notes: Same two-buffer fabric contract. All three designs pass timing; resource and throughput tradeoffs remain.

comparisons.name: N=16384/q54 NGen and OpenNTT
comparisons.notes: Both designs pass routed timing. Registered-issue NGen trades more LUT/BRAM for lower latency and fewer FF/DSP than OpenNTT. Earlier failed NGen revisions remain in separate reports.

comparisons.name: Kyber storage and arithmetic ablation
comparisons.notes: Compact banked Kyber requires serialized host transactions and complete buffer loading. Synthesis qualification is not routed closure.

comparisons.name: NGen and SGen YATA permutation choices
comparisons.notes: Composed switch/stride designs pass arithmetic but fail setup under the stated target.

comparisons.name: HOGE forward hardware comparison
comparisons.notes: Extracted HOGE passes synthesis timing; NGen full-throughput fails setup and hold. The shorter simulated NGen transaction is not a qualified 250 MHz advantage.
